questions.question: Density of population, is expressed as ___________ .

options.text: number of rural persons per unit area
number of literate persons per unit area
number of persons per unit area
number of animals and persons per unit area

questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** number of persons per unit area.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Density of population:-**

 
 
• It​ is the **number of individuals **or inhabitants **per unit area.**
 
• It is usually expressed in terms of **persons per square kilometer **or **square mile.**
 
• The density of population is an important indicator of the **level of development and growth** of a particular region or country.
 
• It helps in assessing the availability of **resources, infrastructure, and services** for the people living in that area.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Number of rural persons per unit area:-

 
 
• It is **not an accurate measure** of population density as it only considers the rural population and **excludes urban areas.**
 
 
 
• Number of literate persons per unit area:-
 
 
• It is also **not an accurate measure **of population density as it only considers the literate population and **excludes illiterate individuals.**
 
 
 
• **Number of animals and persons per unit area:-**
 
 
• It is **not an appropriate measure **of population density as it combines two different types of populations and does not provide an **accurate representation of human population density.**

questions.question: The ___________ is a meeting of all adults who live in the area covered by a Panchayat.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gram Sabha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gram Sabha** is a **village assembly** consisting of **all the adults** who reside in the area covered by a **Panchayat.**
 
• It is the primary unit of **decision-making** in the **Panchayati Raj system.**
 
• The Gram Sabha meets **at least twice a year** to discuss various issues related to the village, such as** sanitation, health, education, agriculture, and infrastructure.**
 
• The Gram Sabha **elects the members of the Panchayat, **which is the **local self-government body **responsible for the **administration of the village.**
 
• The Gram Sabha also has the power to **approve the annual budget **of the Panchayat, **review its performance**, and** initiate development projects** in the village.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vidhan Sabha** is the **lower house** of the state legislature in India.

 
 
• It is** elected by the people** of the state and has the power to make **laws, approve the state budget, and scrutinize **the work of the government.
 
 
 
• **Lok Sabha **is the **lower house** of the **parliament **of India.
 
 
• It is **elected by the people of India** and has the power to make **laws, approve the national budget, and hold** the government accountable.
 
 
 
• **Rajya Sabha** is the **upper house** of the parliament of India.
 
 
• It is **not directly elected by the people** but is composed of members who are **elected by the state legislatures.**
 
• Its role is to represent the **interests of the states **and act as a check on the **power of the Lok Sabha.**

• The Tabla is played with the **fingers and palms of the hands**, and the player can create a wide range of sounds by **varying the pressure and position of the fingers** and palms on the drums.

• **Sitar** is a** stringed instrument** that is played with a **plectrum, **and it is used in** Indian classical music** and **popular music.**
 
• Alla Rakha was** not known **for playing any of these instruments, but he was a** master Tabla player** who collaborated with many famous musicians and performed all over the world.

questions.question: Provisions related to the seat of the "Supreme Court of India" is mentioned in which article?

__
 
• **Article 130 **of the Indian Constitution mentions the** seat of the Supreme Court of India.**
 
• **Article 129 **empowers the Supreme Court to** punish for contempt of itself.**
 
• **Article 131** provides for the **original jurisdiction** of the Supreme Court in certain **disputes** between the **Government of India** and one or more **States.**
 
• **Article 132 **provides for the** appellate jurisdiction** of the Supreme Court in certain cases.
 
• **Option 1 **(Article 132) is** incorrect** as it deals with the appellate jurisdiction of the Supreme Court, not the seat.
 
• **Option 2** (Article 131) is** incorrect** as it deals with the original jurisdiction of the Supreme Court in certain disputes, not the seat.
 
• **Option 4** (Article 129) is **incorrect** as it deals with the power of the Supreme Court to punish for contempt, not the seat. 
 
• Hence, the **correct answer** is option 3 (Article 130). 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Supreme Court of India** was established on **January 28, 1950**, after India became a republic.
 
• The** seat of the Supreme Court **of India is in **New Delhi.**
 
• The Supreme Court of India is the** highest court** of the land and has the power of **judicial review.**

questions.question: Duties levied on goods produced within the country are ___________ .
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**excise taxes.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Excise taxes:-**

 
 
• These are levied on goods produced within the country for domestic consumption.
 
• These taxes are imposed at the manufacturing stage and are included in the price of the product.
 
• Excise taxes are different from customs duties which are levied on goods imported into the country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anti-dumping taxes:-**

 
 
• These are imposed on imported goods that are sold at prices lower than their normal value in the exporting country to protect the domestic industry. 
 
 
 
• **Wealth taxes:-**
 
 
• These are levied on the net wealth of individuals or companies and are not related to the production or sale of goods
 
 
 
• **Custom duties:-**
 
 
• These are taxes imposed on goods that are imported into the country from foreign nations. They are also known as import duties or tariffs.

questions.question: The ozone layer is found in which of the following layers of the atmosphere?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Stratosphere**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ozone layer:-**

 
 
• **It is a layer of gas in the stratosphere that protects the Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation from the sun.**
 
• It is primarily made up of ozone molecules and is located approximately 10-50 kilometers above the Earth's surface.
 
• The ozone layer is important for the survival of various species on Earth, including humans, as prolonged exposure to UV radiation can lead to skin cancer, cataracts, and other health problems.
 
• The depletion of the ozone layer is primarily caused by human-made chemicals like chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) that have been used in refrigerants, aerosol sprays, and other industrial processes. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Troposphere, mesosphere, and exosphere, do not contain significant amounts of ozone and are not responsible for protecting the Earth from UV radiation. **

• She was born on** 9 January 1831, and passed away on 9 October 1900. Sheikh is widely** considered to be India’s first Muslim woman teacher.
 
• She is remembered for her pioneering role in educating and empowering women and marginalized communities during the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
 
• **Fatima Sheikh was deeply committed to the education and empowerment of women.**
 
• She believed that education was the key to unlocking the potential of women and helping them to improve their lives and the lives of those around them. **Her tireless efforts and dedication to empower women, especially from marginalized communities, played a crucial role in advancing women’s rights in India and helped to pave the way for future generations.**

questions.question: The innermost part of a flower is called the __________ .
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**pistil.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pistil:-**

 
 
• The innermost part of a flower is called the pistil, which is the female reproductive organ of the flower.
 
• The pistil is made up of three parts: the stigma, the style, and the ovary.
 
• The stigma is the sticky tip of the pistil where pollen grains land and begin to grow.
 
• The style is the slender tube that connects the stigma to the ovary.
 
• The ovary contains the ovules, which are the eggs that, when fertilized by pollen, develop into seeds.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7238912662fe6f931b9b241c775cd6ae485aa258a7ac4d88d6edbf8ed1c5bce2.png] 

 ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Stamens:-**

 
 
• These are the male reproductive organs of a flower and are located around the pistil.
 
• They consist of the anther, which produces pollen, and the filament, which supports the anther.
 
 
 
• **Petals:-**
 
 
• These are the colorful, often fragrant, parts of a flower that attract pollinators.
 
 
 
• **Sepals**:-
 
 
• These are the outermost parts of a flower and protect the developing bud.
 
• They are usually green and leaf-like in appearance.
